author: GameSpot YouTube
text:
Overwatch New Hero Doctrine GAMEPLAY
We went hands on with the new Overwatch hero Doctrine at Blizzcon 2026. 

His Eternal Scepter is a mid-range weapon that heals enemies and damages allies. 

Shrouded Momentum allows him to rush forward with damage reduction and Invigorating Drones can be deployed on an ally to grant them attack speed an healing. Either ability can then be Infused to give it a boost; Shrouded Momentum gains free flight and Invigorating Drones deploys robotic bats on Doctrine too. 

His ultimate, Deliverance, unleashes a swarm of drones that reduces the maximum health of enemies and grants allies overhealth. 

Doctrine is available via a limited hero trial until September 15 and then joins the game permanently when season 5 releases on October 6.
